comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Clementi MRT about 730 m, Dover MRT about 2,260 m; closer than 127 of 462 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 4 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Nan Hua Primary School about 210 m; more than 409 of 462 similar developments (the same as 53). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 690 m), more than 206 of 462 similar developments (the same as 81); nearest hawker centre Ayer Rajah Market about 750 m; nearest park Holland Green Linear Park about 1,660 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: West Coast MRT about 820 m (LTA target 2032) and Maju MRT about 1,990 m (LTA target 2032), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Faber Residence, 386 new sales, about 750 m; Elta, 81 new sales, about 1,540 m; Nava Grove, 77 new sales, about 1,760 m; Pinetree Hill, 58 new sales, about 1,890 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 30 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 602 new sales and 496 resales (1,098 purchases); new sales were 54.8% of these purchases. Subsales (37) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 496 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 83 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 496 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 496 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (0%). Planning-area private resales −0.7%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
